title: ChIPmentation
scope: Schmidl 2015 ChIPmentation implementation: enrichment of fragmented chromatin, on-bead Tn5 transposition, and downstream DNA recovery/purification/amplification. Both attached depictions show this single route with no retained alternative branch. The leftmost chromatin drawing and long ChIPmentation caption identify the assay rather than an extra action. The poster’s Histone methylation and Chia-PET rows, its clipped upper-row text, and ATAC-seq mentioned in catalogue prose are outside this extraction. The final product is a physical DNA library; sequencing and analysis are not depicted.

operations.label: Chromatin immunoprecipitation

operations.information_effect: DNA associated with the captured target is enriched. Specificity and applicability depend on antibody quality; capture is not a claim of perfect biological specificity.
